headline: Higher electricity bills spark surge in user complaints
summary: Consumers in the Dominican Republic, including a family in Santo Domingo Norte, say electricity bills have risen without a proportional increase in usage. They are demanding greater transparency from the power service.
why: Electricity tariffs and billing directly affect household spending power and the cost base of businesses. Disputes over pricing can lead to regulatory scrutiny of utilities.
original_headline: Facturas eléctricas más altas disparan las quejas de los usuarios
